BEFORE THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY Order 09.09.2024 Heard Mr.
KP Pathak, learned legal Aid counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard Mr. S Mitra, learned counsel for the respondent No. 1 and Ms. S Baruah, learned counsel for the respondent No. 3.

The present writ petition is filed, inter-alia, alleging that though the petitioner is a co- pattadar of a plot of land in Barpalaha village in Bar Bangsar Mouza, Kamrup district which was used by the respondent GAIL, however, no compensation was paid to the petitioner.

The respondent GAIL has filed an affidavit and has submitted that the matter relates to apportionment of compensation amongst the land owners and therefore, the matter has already been referred to the jurisdictional District Judge in terms of the Section 11 of Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962.

entities.text: Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid stand, Mr. Pathak submits that as the matter has been referred to proper forum, this writ petition can be disposed of requesting the learned Page No.# 3/3 jurisdictional District Judge to consider and decide the matter at earliest.
The learned counsel for the GAIL has also submitted that the proper course of action should be to close this matter.

This court is also of the view that since the apportionment between the land owners is now pending before the jurisdictional District Judge, nothing survives to be adjudicated in the present writ petition.
Accordingly, same stands closed.
However, this court expects that the learned court shall take the matter on record and proceed in accordance with law.
